semantics: Runtime V2 process-local typed carriers use exact destination-owned storage, one descriptor per owner region, and fail-closed compiler/runtime identity.

enums.name: rt_value_flags
enums.semantics: Independent semantic capabilities attached to one monomorphic value descriptor.

values.name: RT_VALUE_FLAG_COPY
values.semantics: Ordinary copies may initialize an independent destination.

values.name: RT_VALUE_FLAG_CLONABLE
values.semantics: clone_init is present under the Copy-or-valid-__clone rule.

values.name: RT_VALUE_FLAG_DROPPABLE
values.semantics: drop_in_place is present and must run exactly once for an initialized obligation.

values.name: RT_VALUE_FLAG_TRACEABLE
values.semantics: trace is present and visits every live VM or GC root.

values.name: RT_VALUE_FLAG_SHARD_MOVABLE
values.semantics: cross_move_init may transfer the value between shards.

values.name: RT_VALUE_FLAG_CROSS_CLONABLE
values.semantics: cross_clone_init may create the design-defined crossing duplicate without invoking user __clone.

enums.name: rt_carrier_status
enums.semantics: Internal returning outcomes; allocator exhaustion and process-terminal panic are deliberately absent.

values.name: RT_CARRIER_STATUS_OK
values.semantics: The documented operation committed successfully.

values.name: RT_CARRIER_STATUS_OVERFLOW
values.semantics: Checked layout or byte planning overflowed; destination stays empty and source stays owned.

values.name: RT_CARRIER_STATUS_CAPACITY
values.semantics: The bounded destination or plan allocator refused capacity before publication.

values.name: RT_CARRIER_STATUS_STALE_GENERATION
values.semantics: A generation changed; no destination publication or source transfer occurred.

values.name: RT_CARRIER_STATUS_PUBLICATION_REJECTED
values.semantics: The owner rejected publication; partial destination state is rolled back to empty.

values.name: RT_CARRIER_STATUS_PLAN_MISMATCH
values.semantics: Cross initialization disagreed with its read-only plan and must follow the internal invariant path.

values.name: RT_CARRIER_STATUS_INVALID_STATE
values.semantics: A slot lifecycle precondition was violated and no ownership commit occurred.

enums.name: rt_slot_state
enums.semantics: One exact lifecycle state for each typed payload slot, including zero-sized values.

values.name: RT_SLOT_EMPTY
values.semantics: No initialized value obligation exists.

values.name: RT_SLOT_INITIALIZED
values.semantics: Exactly one initialized value obligation exists.

values.name: RT_SLOT_CLAIMED
values.semantics: Exclusive detached work owns the initialized obligation outside the owner lock.

values.name: RT_SLOT_MOVED
values.semantics: The obligation transferred to a destination.

values.name: RT_SLOT_DROPPED
values.semantics: The obligation was destroyed exactly once.

enums.name: rt_cross_mode
enums.semantics: Selects the compiler-generated ownership operation used by one immutable cross plan.

values.name: RT_CROSS_MOVE
values.semantics: Transfer one movable source obligation.

values.name: RT_CROSS_CLONE
values.semantics: Create the crossing-defined duplicate while retaining the source obligation.

records.name: rt_value_layout
records.semantics: Target-resolved physical facts and authoritative semantic flags for one concrete monomorphic value.

fields.name: size
fields.semantics: ABI bytes including tail padding; zero is valid only for a real zero-sized value.

fields.name: align
fields.semantics: Required base alignment and always at least one.

fields.name: stride
fields.semantics: Repeated-element displacement; zero for a zero-sized value.

fields.name: flags
fields.semantics: Capability bits derived by the semantic classifier, not guessed by layout.

records.name: rt_cross_allocation
records.semantics: One successful allocation returned by the plan-limited crossing allocator.

fields.name: storage
fields.semantics: Allocated storage, null only when the status is not OK.

fields.name: size
fields.semantics: Charged allocation bytes.

fields.name: align
fields.semantics: Alignment satisfied by storage.

records.name: rt_trace_visitor
records.semantics: Borrowed visitor state used only for the duration of one trace callback.

fields.name: context
fields.semantics: Visitor-owned opaque context.

fields.name: visit
fields.semantics: Non-null root visitor callback.

records.name: rt_cross_allocator
records.semantics: Mutable plan-limited allocator state with exact byte and allocation-count allowances. A nonzero request consumes its exact bytes and one allocation only after the callback returns OK; refusal leaves both allowances unchanged. Zero-size requests and allowance mismatches return PLAN_MISMATCH.

fields.name: context
fields.semantics: Allocator-owned opaque context.

fields.name: allocate
fields.semantics: Non-null bounded allocation callback.

fields.name: remaining_bytes
fields.semantics: Unspent exact bytes from sidecar_bytes; decremented by the nonzero requested size only after a successful allocation.

fields.name: remaining_allocations
fields.semantics: Unspent exact successful sidecar allocation calls from sidecar_count; decremented once only after a successful nonzero allocation.

records.name: rt_cross_plan
records.semantics: POD, self-contained immutable preflight result passed unchanged to cross initialization. It owns no storage and contains no instance-dependent pointer; ops is process-static. Copies are independently safe for concurrent or reentrant reservation/apply. Refusing a reservation requires no plan cleanup.

fields.name: ops
fields.semantics: Whole-process descriptor for the planned value.

fields.name: mode
fields.semantics: Immutable requested mode; cross initialization rejects a move/clone mismatch before touching source or destination.

fields.name: envelope_bytes
fields.semantics: Fixed envelope and header bytes charged to transport.

fields.name: payload_offset
fields.semantics: Aligned byte offset of the exact inline payload.

fields.name: payload_bytes
fields.semantics: Exact inline payload bytes.

fields.name: payload_align
fields.semantics: Alignment required at payload_offset.

fields.name: sidecar_bytes
fields.semantics: Exact aggregate bytes consumed by all successful transport-owned sidecar allocator calls.

fields.name: total_bytes
fields.semantics: Complete charge reserved before source ownership can change.

fields.name: sidecar_count
fields.semantics: Exact number of successful nonzero transport-owned sidecar allocator calls required by apply.

records.name: rt_value_ops
records.semantics: Immutable whole-process monomorphic operations for one homogeneous owner region.

fields.name: layout
fields.semantics: Exact target layout and semantic capabilities.

fields.name: move_init
fields.semantics: Always-present transfer initializer.

fields.name: copy_init
fields.semantics: Present exactly when RT_VALUE_FLAG_COPY is set.

fields.name: clone_init
fields.semantics: Present exactly when RT_VALUE_FLAG_CLONABLE is set.

fields.name: drop_in_place
fields.semantics: Present exactly when RT_VALUE_FLAG_DROPPABLE is set.

fields.name: trace
fields.semantics: Present exactly when RT_VALUE_FLAG_TRACEABLE is set.

fields.name: plan_cross
fields.semantics: Always-present read-only crossing preflight.

fields.name: cross_move_init
fields.semantics: Present exactly when RT_VALUE_FLAG_SHARD_MOVABLE is set.

fields.name: cross_clone_init
fields.semantics: Present exactly when RT_VALUE_FLAG_CROSS_CLONABLE is set.

records.name: rt_key_ops
records.semantics: Monomorphic map-key operations; equality and hashing inspect fields and active arms rather than padding.

fields.name: value
fields.semantics: Complete key value operations embedded once per key region.

fields.name: hash
fields.semantics: Non-null deterministic key hash callback.

fields.name: equal
fields.semantics: Non-null key equality callback.

records.name: rt_slot_header
records.semantics: Lifecycle metadata stored beside exact owner-provided payload storage, never copied callback metadata.

fields.name: state
fields.semantics: Current exact lifecycle state, including for zero-sized payloads.

records.name: rt_descriptor_table_entry
records.semantics: One immutable entry selected by a heterogeneous arm or state index.

fields.name: ops
fields.semantics: Descriptor valid for at least as long as every selected slot.

fields.name: payload_offset
fields.semantics: Target-resolved offset within operation-owned storage.

fields.name: payload_align
fields.semantics: Proven alignment at payload_offset.

records.name: rt_envelope_header
records.semantics: Typed transport envelope metadata whose aligned tail or sidecar owns one exact payload.

fields.name: ops
fields.semantics: Descriptor retained while the envelope payload may be initialized.

fields.name: total_bytes
fields.semantics: Complete physical transport charge held by the envelope.

fields.name: payload_offset
fields.semantics: Aligned payload offset from the envelope base.

fields.name: payload_bytes
fields.semantics: Exact inline payload bytes.

fields.name: payload_align
fields.semantics: Required payload alignment.

fields.name: generation
fields.semantics: Generation checked before late work may publish or clean storage.

fields.name: owner_shard_id
fields.semantics: Shard that owns lifecycle transitions for the payload.

fields.name: slot
fields.semantics: Single payload lifecycle state.

records.name: rt_typed_carrier_handle
records.semantics: One-word opaque language handle; exact typed payload storage remains in the referenced owner.

fields.name: opaque
fields.semantics: Opaque owner identity; not an erased payload and not a public descriptor identity.

callbacks.name: rt_trace_visit_fn
callbacks.semantics: Visits one live handle or root without retaining the passed pointers.

parameters.name: context
parameters.semantics: Borrowed visitor context.

parameters.name: root
parameters.semantics: Borrowed live root representation.

callbacks.name: rt_cross_alloc_fn
callbacks.semantics: Allocates one nonzero sidecar only from bytes and allocation count already reserved by the immutable cross plan. OK must return exactly the requested size and a compatible alignment; the caller then consumes that exact size and one allocation. A refusal leaves both allowances unchanged.

result.semantics: OK initializes out with the exact nonzero request; a returned refusal leaves out storage null and the allocator allowances unchanged. A zero-size request is forbidden and reported as PLAN_MISMATCH before this callback is invoked.

parameters.name: context
parameters.semantics: Borrowed allocator context.

parameters.name: size
parameters.semantics: Requested exact charged bytes; always greater than zero.

parameters.name: align
parameters.semantics: Requested supported alignment.

parameters.name: out
parameters.semantics: Empty allocation result initialized only on OK.

callbacks.name: rt_value_move_init_fn
callbacks.semantics: Initializes an empty destination by transferring exactly one source obligation at the commit point.

result.semantics: This operation has no returning refusal path.

parameters.name: dst
parameters.semantics: Exact aligned empty destination storage.

parameters.name: src
parameters.semantics: Initialized source made logically empty after destination commit.

callbacks.name: rt_value_copy_init_fn
callbacks.semantics: Initializes an independent destination only for a Copy value.

result.semantics: Copy has no returning refusal path.

parameters.name: dst
parameters.semantics: Exact aligned empty destination storage.

parameters.name: src
parameters.semantics: Borrowed initialized source remains owned by its caller.

callbacks.name: rt_value_clone_init_fn
callbacks.semantics: Initializes an independent destination under the Copy-or-valid-__clone rule outside runtime locks.

result.semantics: User panic and allocator exhaustion remain process-terminal rather than returned statuses.

parameters.name: dst
parameters.semantics: Exact aligned empty destination storage.

parameters.name: src
parameters.semantics: Pinned borrowed source retained for the clone duration.

callbacks.name: rt_value_drop_in_place_fn
callbacks.semantics: Destroys exactly one initialized obligation outside runtime owner locks.

parameters.name: value
parameters.semantics: Initialized value storage made logically dropped on return.

callbacks.name: rt_value_trace_fn
callbacks.semantics: Visits every live root in one initialized value without changing ownership.

parameters.name: value
parameters.semantics: Borrowed initialized value storage.

parameters.name: visitor
parameters.semantics: Borrowed visitor valid for this call.

callbacks.name: rt_value_plan_cross_fn
callbacks.semantics: Performs a read-only exact-byte and exact-allocation-count preflight before any source ownership change. The source remains exclusively movable for move mode or immutable and pinned for clone mode through both plan and apply.

result.semantics: OK initializes a self-contained plan; every returned refusal leaves it empty and source owned, with no plan cleanup required.

parameters.name: src
parameters.semantics: Source held exclusively movable for move mode or immutable and pinned for clone mode continuously through plan and apply.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.semantics: Requested crossing ownership mode.

parameters.name: out
parameters.semantics: Empty plan destination initialized only on OK.

callbacks.name: rt_value_cross_move_init_fn
callbacks.semantics: Applies one immutable plan by deterministically re-walking the same exclusively movable source. It rejects ops, mode, layout, or exact byte/count totals mismatch before source commit, consumes only the plan-limited allowances, and transfers the source only after destination commit.

result.semantics: A returned failure, including PLAN_MISMATCH from re-walk or allowance disagreement, rolls destination back to empty by dropping every partial destination child and leaves source owned. Success requires both remaining_bytes and remaining_allocations to be zero.

parameters.name: dst
parameters.semantics: Exact aligned destination covered by the plan.

parameters.name: src
parameters.semantics: Initialized exclusively movable source retained unchanged from plan until it is emptied only after commit.

parameters.name: plan
parameters.semantics: Same self-contained immutable plan used for reservation; its ops descriptor is process-static.

parameters.name: allocator
parameters.semantics: Mutable allocator initialized from sidecar_bytes and sidecar_count; refusal leaves allowances unchanged and successful return is accepted only when both reach zero.

callbacks.name: rt_value_cross_clone_init_fn
callbacks.semantics: Applies one immutable plan by deterministically re-walking the same immutable pinned source and performs compiler-generated crossing duplication without user __clone. It rejects ops, mode, layout, or exact byte/count totals mismatch before source commit.

result.semantics: A returned failure, including PLAN_MISMATCH from re-walk or allowance disagreement, rolls destination back to empty by dropping every partial destination child and retains source ownership. Success requires both remaining_bytes and remaining_allocations to be zero.

parameters.name: dst
parameters.semantics: Exact aligned destination covered by the plan.

parameters.name: src
parameters.semantics: Immutable pinned source retained unchanged and owned continuously through plan and apply.

parameters.name: plan
parameters.semantics: Same self-contained immutable plan used for reservation; its ops descriptor is process-static.

parameters.name: allocator
parameters.semantics: Mutable allocator initialized from sidecar_bytes and sidecar_count; refusal leaves allowances unchanged and successful return is accepted only when both reach zero.

callbacks.name: rt_key_hash_fn
callbacks.semantics: Hashes initialized key fields and the active union arm without reading padding.

parameters.name: key
parameters.semantics: Borrowed initialized key.

callbacks.name: rt_key_equal_fn
callbacks.semantics: Compares initialized key fields and the active union arm without reading padding.

result.semantics: One for equal and zero for unequal.

parameters.name: a
parameters.semantics: First borrowed initialized key.

parameters.name: b
parameters.semantics: Second borrowed initialized key.

runtime_functions.name: rt_typed_carrier_abi_manifest_hash
runtime_functions.semantics: Returns debug evidence for the runtime manifest identity and is never used to accept, negotiate, or select an ABI.

runtime_functions.name: rt_value_copy_init_unbound_trap
runtime_functions.semantics: An aborting trap, not a copy. It is the named non-null value every descriptor that sets RT_VALUE_FLAG_COPY without a per-type copy binds into copy_init, so the flag and its callback slot agree and the slot's identity says the copy width is the descriptor's rt_value_layout.size. It is never dispatched: the frozen rt_value_copy_init_fn signature carries no width, so the copy is performed by the runtime helper that still holds the descriptor and that helper branches away from this symbol. Reaching this body means the slot was dispatched directly, without the width it needs; it copies nothing, writes the diagnosis to stderr and aborts the process rather than returning a destination its owner would publish as initialized.

result.semantics: It does not return. The only path that reaches this body is an internal error and it aborts.

parameters.name: dst
parameters.semantics: The destination the frozen callback contract obliges a caller to pass. This body never writes it, so it carries no writeonly.

parameters.name: src
parameters.semantics: The source the frozen callback contract obliges a caller to pass. This body never reads it, so it carries no readonly.
